utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What’s the main thing you still need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking—has Noah confirmed the repair drive time and drop-off spot yet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure yet—have you heard back from Noah?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Could you bring the old charger and any spare cables you’ve got? If you have a busted phone too, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes—please bring the old charger, any spare cables, and a busted phone if you have one. That’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’ll bring the charger and any spare cables I can find. I’ll check for a busted phone too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — I’ll bring the list and may send a quick reminder if needed. Really appreciate you helping out with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course, Hana — just bring the list when you can, and I’ll check my shed for tools once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I’ll get the list over to you soon and send a reminder if needed. Thanks again for checking your shed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s now on Sunday at the community center, Rey. I can help line up volunteers and supplies if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa—I’d really appreciate that. Let’s do Sunday at the community center, and I’ll count on you for volunteers and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Rey — I’ll line up the volunteers and check on supplies. Let me know if there’s anything specific you want me to prioritize.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still haven’t heard the exact drop-off spot for the repair drive—do you know where it’s set up yet?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, got it — Sunday at the community center. I hadn’t heard that update yet, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks for checking in, Dane. We could still use help sorting tools and greeting folks at the front porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks — front porch this Saturday works. I’ll keep track of the setup there and can help sort tools or greet folks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s perfect, Opal—thank you. I really appreciate you helping with setup, sorting tools, and greeting folks on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, thanks for the reminder. If there’s anything useful I can drop by the community hall, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Noah—if you spot any tools, tape, or spare parts, that’d be a big help. I’m heading over later, so I can carry them in then.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing—I’ll keep an eye out for tools, tape, or spare parts and bring anything I find by the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? It’s really coming together nicely—people are dropping off tools and spare parts over by the community hall. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess—that’s helpful. So it’s at the community hall on Sunday, and I can plan around school from there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, actually it’s this Saturday at the front porch, not Sunday at the community hall. I’ll let you know if anything changes!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not quite yet—we could still use a few more volunteers. It starts this Saturday on the front porch, and people should bring repairs there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it, Mina—I'll keep an eye out for the volunteer count. If you still need me, I can bring my tools on Saturday to the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That would be great, Gus—please do bring your tools on Saturday. We’ll likely need the extra hands too, so I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mara — I’m still lining up helpers for Saturday at the front porch, so if you can spread the word or lend a hand, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word and I can help at the front porch on Saturday. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mara — that would be a huge help. See you Saturday at the front porch!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds best to me too — I’ll wait for the confirmed details before I plan anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll send you the remaining fixes for the repair drive soon, so you can plan once everything’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate that. I’ll hold off on planning until I have the confirmed details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo — I could really use help setting up the front porch and sorting tools for Saturday. If you can, that would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I can help set up the front porch and sort the tools for Saturday. I’ll make sure we’ve got everything lined up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll be there early Saturday, and I really appreciate you helping me get everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — tools, spare parts, and repair supplies, got it. I can bring something by the community hall, and maybe mention it to a couple neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be wonderful, Noah — I’ll keep spreading the word and swing by the porch Saturday to help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll bring something by the community hall and tell a couple neighbors. Saturday on the porch works for me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? It’s shaping up nicely—folks are dropping off tools and spare parts, and I’m keeping an ear out for any last-minute updates.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh good — just tell me the main thing you still need from me, and I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great, Bo — I could really use someone to help set up the front porch this Saturday and keep an eye on the drop-off table.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on, right? Just let me know when Noah confirms the time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, it’s still on—I’m just waiting on Noah to confirm the time and drop-off spot. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—thanks. I’ll wait for Noah’s confirmation on the time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard it’s going well and that people are dropping off tools and spare parts by the community hall. I still don’t know the exact spot, though.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s moved to Sunday at the community center now — not the front porch. I’ll pass along if I hear the exact drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps — Sunday at the community center, got it. I’ll keep an ear out too in case the exact drop-off spot gets passed around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure — it’s the repair drive for tools, spare parts, and repair supplies, and folks can drop them off by the community hall. I’m spreading the word around the block too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to a few folks and see who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Vik — that would really help. I’ll keep putting up invites around the block and by the community hall too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re getting a nice bit of support already, but I could still use a few more hands. If you’re free, please come by the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—what time on Saturday should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mina—could you come by around 10 in the morning? That’ll give us time to get everything set up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey—that’ll help a lot. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, see you Sunday at the community center for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Going well. I still need a couple helpers Saturday at the front porch—can you pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help at the front porch on Saturday. I’ll keep an eye out for any tools or spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Rey. Just show up Saturday at the front porch, and if you spot any tools or spare parts, bring them along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: What can I do to help with the repair drive? Just point me to the task and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam — could you help spread the word that it’s now Sunday at the community center? If you’re able, please also bring any tools or supplies there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll help spread the word and bring some tools to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the start time and drop-off spot, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Pia — I’m still confirming the drop-off spot too, and I’ll let you know if I hear the front porch is set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an eye out too, and once we know the porch or another spot, I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you send me the time and place again? I want to make sure I’ve got the repair drive details right before I help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center. I was thinking Saturday morning around 9 before, but the new plan should be easier around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — so it’s Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at 9, right? I’ll share that once I’ve got it confirmed.
